messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] us-east-1 /v1/generate elevated 5xx rate detected (12% across gateway). Paging @jordan_oncall and oncall rotation.

sarah_k: Oncall here, grabbing dashboards — will start triage. :wave:

matt_r: Looking at scheduler queues: batcher queue length spiked -> 48k pending, tail latency > 4s, head-of-line blocking on scheduler-1.

anya_g: Observing KV cache growth across model-7 replicas; prefetch thrash + OOM eviction churn. suspect cache lock contention -> batcher stalls.

devon_s: Customer impact: multiple enterprise customers seeing 502s/timeouts. SparkSheets reported ~30% of requests failing. @ellie_cs can you confirm comms?

ellie_cs: Yep, initial note sent to SparkSheets support and status page updated with "Investigating". Will send follow-up when we have mitigation.

matt_r: Relevant logs:
```
2026-03-15T16:20:12Z scheduler-1 ERROR batch_enqueue timeout=3000ms queued=48234 err=gateway_error/503
2026-03-15T16:20:14Z model-7 WARN kv_cache evict_count=1200 prefetch_fail=1
2026-03-15T16:20:18Z gateway ERROR upstream_timeout target=/v1/generate pid=12 rc=504
```

sarah_k: Quick mitigation I'm trying: scale batcher replicas and open a temporary fallback route to model-v2 (smaller KV footprint).

sarah_k: Commands I ran:
```
kubectl scale deployment batcher -n inference --replicas=10
kubectl patch svc inference-gateway -p '{"spec": {"externalTrafficPolicy": "Local"}}'
```

anya_g: Also toggled `enable_kv_prefetch=false` for model-7 rollout group to reduce thrash (canary flag).

jordan_oncall: Taking pager. 30m window, I'll coordinate. @matt_r please keep metric snippets in channel. ; I'll start temporary traffic split: 30% -> dedicated-pool-us-east.

matt_r: Patch to routing rule:
```
route add /v1/generate -> dedicated-pool-us-east weight=30
```
Applied. Monitoring.

ops-bot: autoscaler: batcher replicas scaled from 3 -> 10 (trigger: queue_len>20k) ; cpu avg -> 42%

matt_r: Seeing queue drain now, queued -> 6k, tail latency 420ms, error rate dropping.

devon_s: Customer update drafted: "We're seeing elevated errors affecting some requests in us-east. We've applied routing and scaling mitigations; next update in 15m." Approved by @ellie_cs.

incidents-bot: Error rate in us-east /v1/generate: 12% -> 1.8% over 8m. Gateway timeouts falling. :white_check_mark:

jordan_oncall: Good work. Root cause hypothesis: KV cache growth + prefetch thrash caused scheduler batcher starvation (head-of-line) leading to upstream timeouts and 5xx. We'll collect heap profiles and cache metrics for postmortem.

sarah_k: Handing off notes to @jordan_oncall: actions taken, commands, current metrics, affected customers list in thread.

jordan_oncall: I'll consolidate into incident doc and kick off a postmortem; severity -> P2 given customer impact. Assigning to @anya_g for cache root cause investigation and @matt_r for routing/autoscale follow-up.

ellie_cs: I've sent a status update to SparkSheets with ETA ~30m and will keep them posted.

ops-bot: Incident closed alert would be emitted after 30m of stable error rate.

sarah_k: Thanks all. Switching to async. :bow:

jordan_oncall: Closing real-time paging. Leave thread for follow-up. Postmortem request filed.
